title: Telecommunications (Fees Amendment) 2008 | No. 10 of 2008
text:
SAINT VINCENT AND THE GRENADINES
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDERS
2008 NO. 10
_________________________________
(Gazetted 22nd April, 2008)
_________________________________
IN EXERCISE of the powers conferred by section 72 of the
Telecommunications Act, 2001, the Minister makes the following Regulations:
TELECOMMUNICATIONS (FEES) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS, 2008
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Telecommunications Citation
(Fees) (Amendment) Regulations 2008.
2. The Telecommunications (Fees) Regulations, 2007, are Amendment of
amended in Schedule 3 by inserting the following in the Frequency Schedule 3,
Authorisation Table after Licence code M C O: SRO 3 of 2007
LICENCE CODE DESCRIPTION SPECTRUM FEES
APPLICATION ANNUAL
MSR Microwave-Subscriber $1,000.00
TV Relay
6Mhz bandwidth $1000.00/frequency
Made this 9th day of April 2008.
HON. DR. JERROL THOMPSON
Minister of Telecommunications,
Science, Technology and Industry
